concrement.definition:
n. A growing together; the collection or mass formed by
   concretion, or natural union.
concrement.translation: [医] 凝结物, 凝结体, 结石

concrescence.definition:
n. Coalescence of particles; growth; increase by the
   addition of particles.
concrescence.translation:
n. 愈合, 合生
[医] 结合; 结合牙

concrescent.translation: [医]接合, 合生, 愈合; 愈着

concrete.definition:
n. a strong hard building material composed of sand and gravel and cement and water
v. cover with cement
v. form into a solid mass; coalesce
a. capable of being perceived by the senses; not abstract or imaginary
concrete.translation:
n. 凝结物, 混凝土
a. 具体的, 实在的, 混凝土的
v. (使)凝结, 用混凝土浇筑

concrete details.translation: [法] 具体细节, 具体情节

concrete form oil.translation: [化] 混凝土滑模油; 混凝土模油; 混凝土模板用油

concrete jungle.translation: n. “混凝土建成的野兽世界”（指资本主义国家弱肉强食的大城市）

concrete mixing machine.translation: [建] 混凝土混合机, 调泥机

concrete pump.translation: [化] 混凝土泵; 混凝土输送泵

concrete-mixers.translation: (concrete-mixer 的复数) 混凝土混合机

concreted.translation:
a. 混凝土的；实在的, 具体的；有形的
vi. 凝结
vt. 使凝固；用混凝土修筑
n. 具体物；凝结物

concreteness.definition: n. the quality of being concrete (not abstract)

concreter.definition:
a capable of being perceived by the senses; not abstract or imaginary
s formed by the coalescence of particles

concretes.definition:
n a strong hard building material composed of sand and gravel and cement and water
v cover with cement
v form into a solid mass; coalesce
concretes.translation: n. 混凝土( concrete的名词复数 ); 具体物; （图案式）有形诗; 图案诗体

concreting.definition: p. pr & vb. n. of Concrete

concretio.translation: [医] 凝结物, 结石; 粘连; 凝结(作用)

concretion.definition: n. the formation of stonelike objects within a body organ (e.g., the kidneys)
concretion.translation:
n. 凝固, 凝固物, 结石
[医] 凝结物, 结石; 粘连; 凝结(作用)

concretionary.definition:
a. Pertaining to, or formed by, concretion or
   aggregation; producing or containing concretions.
concretionary.translation: a. 凝固的, 凝固而成的, 含凝块的

concretions.definition:
plural of concretion
n. the formation of stonelike objects within a body organ (e.g., the kidneys)
concretions.translation:
(concretion 的复数) n. 凝固, 凝固物, 结石
[医] 凝结物, 结石; 粘连; 凝结(作用)

concretised.definition:
past tense of concretise
v become specific

concretism.definition: n a representation of an abstract idea in concrete terms

concretist.translation: n. & adj.具体派诗人(的), 具体主义者(的)

concretive.translation: a. 凝结性的, 有凝固力的

concretively.translation: adv. 有凝结力地, 凝结性地

concretize.definition:
v. make something concrete
v. become specific

concretized.definition:
v make something concrete
v become specific
concretized.translation: v. 使具体化, 使有形化( concretize的过去式和过去分词 )

concretizes.definition:
v make something concrete
v become specific
concretizes.translation: v. 使具体化, 使有形化( concretize的第三人称单数 )

concretizing.definition:
v make something concrete
v become specific
concretizing.translation: v. 使具体化, 使有形化( concretize的现在分词 )
